## Objective

Finish `report/REPORT.md` and the slide deck described in
`slides/README.md`, both submitted to the instructor before Module 6, not
walked in with on the day.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `report/REPORT.md` explains the extension, including the code and the results, filled in against every section the template already lists
- [ ] The report cites related follow-up work on the same baseline and states explicitly how your extension differs from it (silence on this point is itself a flag, per the idea-pitch issue's own related-work check)
- [ ] If only a smoke test was run anywhere, the report says so plainly and states what full-scale validation would require
- [ ] Slides: a cover slide, a references slide, and no more than 6 content slides in between, covering the baseline paper's problem, solution, and results, then the extension idea and results, in that order
- [ ] Both submitted to the instructor before Module 6

## Who is doing what

Replace this with real names before starting work. Every checklist item needs exactly one owner.

## Pull requests closing this issue

Link them here as they open, for example: `Closes #<number>` in the PR description does this automatically.

## Before Module 6

Re-read this issue and the syllabus rubric together. Any of the three of
you can be asked about any part at the defense, the baseline paper, the
extension, or the code. That is what the Module 6 defense specifically
checks for.
